prompt.zh-TW: 阿哲融資買的股票下跌，收到券商的追繳通知。三個做法都說得通，你會怎麼選？
prompt.en: Shares Che bought on margin have fallen and the broker has issued a margin call. Three courses of action are all defensible; which would you choose?

text.zh-TW: 補繳現金，把維持率拉回門檻之上
text.en: Top up with cash to lift the maintenance ratio back above the threshold

upside.zh-TW: 保住全部部位，若股價回升可以完整參與；不必在低點賣股。
upside.en: Keeps the whole position, so any recovery is fully captured; nothing is sold at the low.

downside.zh-TW: 要拿出更多現金，等於加碼在下跌的股票上；如果繼續跌，還會再被追繳。
downside.en: Requires more cash, in effect adding to a falling share; if it keeps falling, another margin call follows.

text.zh-TW: 賣掉一部分股票，用賣得的錢償還部分融資
text.en: Sell part of the holding and use the proceeds to repay part of the loan

upside.zh-TW: 不必再投入新資金；融資金額變小，維持率回升，利息負擔也下降。
upside.en: No new money is needed; the loan shrinks, the maintenance ratio rises and the interest burden falls.

downside.zh-TW: 在低點實現了部分虧損，剩下的部位變小，回升時賺得比較少。
downside.en: Part of the loss is crystallised at the low, and the smaller position gains less in any recovery.

text.zh-TW: 以其他有價證券補充擔保品
text.en: Pledge other securities as additional collateral

upside.zh-TW: 不動用現金，也不必賣出下跌的股票，擔保品總值提高。
upside.en: Uses no cash and sells none of the falling shares, while the total collateral rises.

downside.zh-TW: 把更多資產綁進同一個帳戶，若整體市場下跌，風險反而集中。
downside.en: Ties more assets into the same account; if the whole market falls, risk becomes more concentrated.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 三個做法對應三種取捨：你最不想失去反彈的機會，會補現金；最不想再投入資金，會減碼；最想保留現金又不想賣，會補擔保品。共同點是：追繳通知不會自己消失；補繳期限到了，整戶擔保維持率仍然不足，擔保品就會被強制賣出（俗稱斷頭）。現行規定是整戶擔保維持率低於 {{percent:1.3|digits=0}} 時發出追繳通知，通知送達之日起 2 個營業日內要補足（臺灣證券交易所訂定的「證券商辦理有價證券買賣融資融券業務操作辦法」第 54 條、第 55 條，查證於 {{raw:2026-10-24}}）。這一題是觀念練習，不是投資建議。
viewpoint.en: The three options reflect three trade-offs: if missing a rebound worries you most, add cash; if committing more money worries you most, reduce the position; if you want to keep cash and avoid selling, pledge collateral. What they share is that a margin call does not go away by itself: if the account-wide collateral maintenance ratio is still short when the top-up deadline passes, the collateral is sold off (forced liquidation). Under current rules a margin call is issued when the account-wide collateral maintenance ratio falls below {{percent:1.3|digits=0}}, and the shortfall must be made up within two business days of the notice being served (Articles 54 and 55 of the Taiwan Stock Exchange’s operating rules for securities firms handling margin purchases and short sales, checked on {{raw:2026-10-24}}). This is a concept exercise, not investment advice.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
